lines.t: My forgiveness runs far and wide,
entering deep into the hearts of those who come to Me in sincere repentance.
Yet many of My sheep believe themselves to be above reproach, and in this do they greatly err.
Therefore let all My beloved grow wise in Me,
and learn also to walk in My ways.
For I am a pillar of strength to those of low degree!
as I renew the hearts of My elect!
Behold, I fill all those who come to Me empty with
as they walk with Me into everlasting life!
Indeed, they shall experience life in abundance, forevermore!...
Life of such a kind, which is only found in Me and I am...
